controls._comment_live_preview: true = live JSON; false = saved animation (other JSON controls then have no effect).
controls._comment_strength: Range 0 to 1; default 1.0. Overall animated effect strength; zero gives the neutral cloner.
controls._comment_spacing_cm: Range 50 to 500; default 160.0. Grid spacing or spacing between rings.
controls._comment_wavelength_cm: Range 100 to 10000; default 1600.0. Distance between wave crests. Try 1800; near/below clone spacing the pattern can look irregular.
controls._comment_speed_hz: Range -2 to 2; default 0.25. Cycles per second, not percent. Try 0.5 (one cycle every 2 seconds); negative reverses travel; 0 freezes the wave.
controls._comment_phase_degrees: Range -360 to 360; default 0.0. Wave phase offset.
controls._comment_direction_degrees: Range -180 to 180; default 25.0. Direction in degrees; affects plane waves only.
controls._comment_base_scale: Range 0.1 to 3; default 0.7. Neutral clone scale multiplier.
controls._comment_scale_wave: Range 0 to 0.9; default 0.45. Wave-driven scale modulation relative to base scale.
controls._comment_rotation_degrees: Range 0 to 180; default 35.0. Wave-driven clone tilt.
controls._comment_spin_degrees_per_second: Range -360 to 360; default 45.0. Continuous clone spin.
controls._comment_noise_cm: Range 0 to 500; default 25.0. Deterministic per-clone bobbing amplitude.
controls._comment_noise_speed_hz: Range 0 to 2; default 0.5. Noise oscillation speed.
controls._comment_falloff_radius_cm: Range 100 to 20000; default 4500.0. Effect fades to zero at this radius. Try 12000 so most clones move; a small radius leaves outer clones still.
controls._comment_color_cycle_hz: Range 0 to 2; default 0.375. Prototype steps per second among three shared material configurations.

_help.edit: Edit the values after each _comment_ hint and SAVE, or use the Motion Graphics Controls panel. Hints are ignored by motion evaluation.
_help.syntax: Keep commas between entries and quotes around text. Use decimal numbers like 0.5, not 500. No // comments or literal line breaks inside strings.
_help.topology: Fixed 32 x 32 for stable IDs; changing topology requires a separate rebuild.
_help.live_preview: false removes the temporary runtime layer and resumes the saved animation.
_help.bake: Saved clip is 8 seconds at 60 time codes/s, sampled every 2 frames. JSON changes are live only until explicitly baked.
